target_definition: First published reported quarterly PAT attributable to owners, including any eventual exceptional items. No new exceptional item is assumed in these forecasts.
normalization_basis: Main adjustments remain zero because the signed statements disclose group pretax costs but not their after-tax owner allocation. Prior Q2 transaction costs 3.0752 cr and prior Q3 transaction costs 1.11 cr plus labour-code expense 2.0673 cr are documented. A separate, explicitly assumed normalization is below.

model_formula: (revenue_cr * ebit_margin + other_income_cr - finance_cost_cr + exceptional_pretax_cr) * (1 - tax_rate) + associates_after_tax_cr - nci_cr
margin_definition: EBIT excluding other income and finance costs, after depreciation and amortisation. This is not EBITDA margin.
rationale: Assume partial conversion of existing equipment orders and a modest improvement in operating mix. Q2 profit recovery is not extrapolated at its sequential growth rate. December FY26 was weak even before its exceptional costs, so repeating that quarter mechanically conflicts with the current backlog evidence. This is a testable operating hypothesis, not proof of a seasonal break.

parameter_assumptions.revenue: 365 cr is 5.3% above current Q2. It assumes some execution of the September backlog. No specific December revenue is assigned to the November 10 order.
parameter_assumptions.ebit_margin: 8.3% versus approximately 7.72% current Q2 and 3.67% Q1. Modest utilization and mix improvement, well below extrapolating the sequential PAT jump.
parameter_assumptions.finance_cost: 8.5 cr, near Q2 8.3901 cr. No immediate deleveraging assumed.
parameter_assumptions.tax_rate: 25% is an analyst group-tax assumption. Q1 effective tax was unstable and prior December showed a tax credit, so a mechanical recent-tax extrapolation is inappropriate.
parameter_assumptions.nci_cr: 1.8 cr, near Q2 1.7127 cr. Subsidiary earnings remain partly attributable to minority shareholders.

adverse.assumptions: Customer acceptance delays and weaker equipment mix. Revenue below Q2, EBIT margin 6.5%, higher effective tax and financing.

base.assumptions: Partial backlog conversion, modest mix improvement, stable financing and normal group tax.

favorable.assumptions: Faster execution of already booked orders and stronger product mix. Revenue 410 cr and EBIT margin 10%. More subsidiary profit also raises NCI.

scenario_interpretation: Uncalibrated operating sensitivities. No probabilities, confidence interval, or claim these exhaust possible outcomes.
unknowns: Backlog is not a quarterly revenue schedule. Management cited a 4-7 month cycle and roughly 210-220 cr of the September backlog for delivery over about three years.
Kinam orders and customer acceptance are lumpy. The USD 42-48m November order extends through November 2028 and commencement conditions are not public.
Tax credits, losses in overseas businesses and NCI can move owner PAT independently of operating profit.
Exact after-tax owner allocation of historical acquisition and labour-code costs is not disclosed.
scope_of_review: Quarterly forecasting supplement. No complete governance, valuation, management-quality, liquidity or portfolio suitability review. No new investment verdict.

issuer_claims.claim: September 30 backlog 1087.3 cr versus 662 cr at June 30. Management expects order conversion and margin improvement in H2.
November 10 Kinam contract USD 42-48m, progressively executed through November 2028, subject to contractual commencement.

normalization_sensitivities.label: Assumed 25% tax benefit and 100% owner allocation of disclosed group costs
normalization_sensitivities.limitation: Neither the tax benefit nor owner allocation is issuer-disclosed. This cannot be substituted silently for reported owner PAT. No adjustment of the separate historical deferred-tax credits is attempted.

baseline_correction: Current owner PAT agrees with frozen extraction. Headline group PAT 16.0197 cr is not the target 14.3070 cr.
